Title: Generally Available: Automated deployments for AKS

Body.Content:
Automated deployments for AKS is now generally available. It simplifies the process of setting up the authorization of a workflow to a repository, generation of a starter application, and configuration of a CI/CD pipeline to build and deploy container images and Kubernetes manifests to a cluster.  

Learn more.
